metadata.scope: Research paper databases, preprint repositories, and academic paper aggregators
metadata.update_strategy: Daily automated crawling of preprints; weekly for aggregators

sources.name: arXiv: Computer Science > Architecture (cs.AR)
sources.focus: Custom accelerators, FPGA designs, heterogeneous systems, hardware architecture for AI
sources.notes: Primary source for custom accelerator research; covers TPUs, GPUs, custom ASICs

sources.name: arXiv: Computer Science > Systems & Distributed Computing (cs.DC)
sources.focus: Distributed inference, disaggregation systems, heterogeneous resource scheduling, network systems
sources.coverage: Distributed systems, parallel computing, network systems
sources.notes: Essential for disaggregated inference, scheduling, and distributed serving papers

sources.name: arXiv: Computer Science > Machine Learning (cs.LG)
sources.focus: Emerging models, scaling laws, efficiency techniques, quantization, pruning, model optimization
sources.coverage: Machine learning, deep learning, model training and optimization
sources.notes: Very high volume; recommend filtering by keywords: quantization, efficiency, inference, roofline

sources.name: Papers with Code
sources.focus: Reproducible research with code implementations; inference system papers, accelerator designs
sources.coverage: All machine learning and computer science papers linked to GitHub code
sources.notes: Filter by categories: inference, systems, optimization. Code availability crucial for reproducibility

sources.name: Emergent Mind: Research Aggregator
sources.focus: AI/ML research papers indexed and categorized; disaggregated inference, heterogeneous systems, custom accelerators
sources.coverage: Broad ML/AI research with curated topic collections
sources.notes: Excellent for discovering related papers via topic collections; disaggregation topic highly relevant

sources.name: arXiv: Electrical Engineering & Systems > Signal Processing (eess.SP)
sources.focus: Signal processing, DSP optimization, hardware-accelerated signal processing, custom processors
sources.coverage: Electrical engineering, signal processing, hardware design
sources.notes: Peripheral; relevant for specialized accelerator designs (audio, video processing)

sources.name: Semantic Scholar API
sources.focus: Full-text search across 200M+ papers; AI summaries, citation graphs, influential classifiers
sources.coverage: Computer science, engineering, physics, life sciences (200M+ papers)
sources.api_authentication: free tier: 5,000 req/5min; key required for higher limits
sources.notes: Excellent for targeted searches (e.g., 'roofline model GPU', 'disaggregated inference'). No RSS; use API

sources.name: OpenAlex API
sources.focus: 250M+ papers from Crossref, MAG, arXiv, PubMed; open science data, citation metrics
sources.coverage: All disciplines; aggregates from multiple sources
sources.api_authentication: free; polite pool with email parameter provides faster responses
sources.notes: Best for citation analysis and broad coverage. Include email in requests for 'polite pool' access
